milestones.text: Avoid using the pronoun "us" in the environment API guide documentation section.
Do not reuse OPTIMIZABLE_ENTRY_RE in this transform hook; leave the regex as before or hoist it under a different variable name.
Retain the specific name OPTIMIZABLE_ENTRY_RE rather than renaming it to a generic name.
Keep the configuration file name (.vscode/settings.json) and shorten the description in the VS Code debugging documentation
Use `npm` as the `runtimeExecutable` in the VS Code debug configuration documentation.
Remove `!depsOptimizer?.isOptimizedDepFile(importer)` and update `optimizedDepChunkRE` to match `\/rolldown-runtime-[A-Z\d]{8}\.js`
Keep the profile output filename without a counter suffix when count is 0 for easier CLI interaction
Use vi.waitUntil without .catch for wait operations so timeouts fail tests explicitly
Treat fully loaded pages that do not load the client runtime as settled during the client wait step
Skip certain asset test cases in bundled-dev mode due to differences in asset URL handling and behavior.
Log module ids as URL paths instead of raw file system paths in bundled-dev HMR client.
Remove top-level null fields from sourcemaps to normalize snapshots.
Drop empty ignoreList fields from sourcemaps to avoid snapshot noise.
Sort keys in sourcemaps to ensure consistent snapshot ordering.
Remove bundled-dev snapshot branches identical to unbundled ones.
Recognize and accept real differences in sourcemaps between bundled and unbundled dev modes.
Ensure sourcemap mappings are valid, not only empty, and continue using snapshots for validation.
Skip the import-analysis plugin test in bundled-dev mode.
Skip certain sourcemap tests for bundled-dev in the Vite repo and move them to the Rollup repo.
Implement leak prevention in Rollup as well.
formatSourcemapForSnapshot removes top-level null fields from sourcemaps.
formatSourcemapForSnapshot drops empty ignoreList fields in sourcemaps.
formatSourcemapForSnapshot sorts keys in sourcemaps before snapshotting.
Remove bundled-dev snapshot branches identical to unbundled ones.
Accept real differences in sourcemaps between bundled and unbundled dev for certain cases.
In unbundled-dev mode, transformRequest drops the generated sourcemap if the original code and the generated code are the same.
Keep the current CI setup because CIs do not run on PRs created by GitHub Actions.
Use explicit type check for configPort to allow port 0 assignment.
Remove the HmrUrl concept to reduce confusion caused by having three different URL representations.
The acceptPath argument of import.meta.hot.accept now receives a ModuleUrl instead of an HmrUrl.
Use the same function with the `resolve` option passed to `nativeDynamicImportVarsPlugin` for resolving subpath imports in dynamic import statements.
Middleware for certain file serving behaviors should be enabled only in unbundled-dev mode.
Add a middleware using the `configureServer` hook in bundled-dev mode to replicate dynamic import behavior.
In bundled dev mode with an app having index.html at project root (normal SPA), bundle output files like /assets/index.js should respond with status 200 served from memory.
In bundled dev mode with no index.html at project root (e.g., fs-serve), source files like /src/main.js should respond with 404.
Denied files such as /.env or /src/dummy.crt should respond with 403 in plain dev mode but respond with 200 and SPA fallback index.html in bundled dev mode with index.html at root.
Files outside root or accessed via /@fs/ with denied extensions should respond with 403 in plain dev, 200 with SPA fallback in bundled dev with index.html, and 404 in bundled dev without index.html.
In bundled-dev mode, when the app has an index.html at the project root (normal SPA), bundle output files like /assets/index.js should be served with HTTP 200 from memory.
In bundled-dev mode with no index.html at project root (e.g., fs-serve), source files like /src/main.js should return 404 instead of SPA fallback.
Denied files such as /.env or /src/dummy.crt should return 403 in plain dev mode but return 200 with SPA fallback in bundled-dev mode with index.html at project root.
Requests for files outside the root directory should return 403 in plain dev mode but return 200 with SPA fallback in bundled-dev mode with index.html at project root.
Requests to /@fs/<abs path>/src/safe.txt should return 200 in plain dev and bundled-dev modes with index.html at project root, but 404 in bundled-dev mode without index.html.
Requests to /@fs/<abs path>/.env should return 403 in plain dev mode but 200 with SPA fallback in bundled-dev mode with index.html at project root, and 404 in bundled-dev mode without index.html.

Requests for files that do not exist should return HTML fallback in plain dev mode, 200 with SPA fallback in bundled-dev mode with index.html at project root, and 404 in bundled-dev mode without index.html.
Skip certain tests in bundled-dev mode when there is no equivalent usage, e.g., in the test file playground/json/__tests__/csr/json-csr.spec.ts at line 40.
Use `page.locator` instead of `page.$` to keep the harness tracking changes to the element.
Close the config bundle in a finally block to ensure resources are released regardless of success or failure of generate() call.
No test is required for this fix due to difficulty in testing and the simplicity of the fix.
Remove the line that deletes a real newline in srcset parsing to preserve newline-separated srcset candidates as space-separated.
Update outdated upstream file links in license comments to current URLs.
Enable the devtools integration for both serve and build modes by default.
Require @vitejs/devtools version 0.6.0 or higher.
Avoid automatically registering the dev-server integration if the user has manually registered DevTools() plugin.
Treat a DevTools configuration object as enabled by default unless enabled: false is explicitly set.
Reuse Vite's existing sortUserPlugins() helper to preserve plugin enforcement order (pre, normal, post).
Support devtools.apply option with values 'serve', 'build', and 'all' to control when DevTools runs.
Build analysis and dev-server inspection remain opt-in integrations requiring separate package installation.
Update documentation to clarify package requirements and default DevTools behavior.
Suppress the "failed to resolve @vitejs/devtools" error until it is confirmed that devtools is enabled.
The devtools option is frozen at config hook time, so any changes to it later are no-ops.
Warn users if they attempt to change the devtools option after initial config resolution.
Do not reuse the same regex variable name for different purposes; keep regex variable names semantically specific to their usage.
Keep the file name for the temporary directory in VS Code settings to guide users where to add it.
Shorten the explanation about the bundle loader and inline source map to reduce wordiness.
Use `npm` as the runtime executable in VS Code debugging configuration.
Preserve a snapshot of environment instances at the start of the HMR update to avoid mixing old and new environments during server restarts.
Record client hook errors against the captured client environment snapshot rather than the current environment instance.
Dispatch the default HMR update using the captured environment list snapshot.
Skip interop rewrite only for relative imports in optimized dep files, not for bare specifiers injected by plugins.
Consider removing the check for optimized dep files in import analysis and instead refine the regex matching optimized dep chunks to only match rolldown-runtime files.
Replace fixed 15s page poll with a three-step bounded wait process under bundled dev.
Use vi.waitUntil without .catch for waits to fail loudly on timeout.
Treat fully loaded pages with no client runtime as settled in client wait step.
Replace fixed 15s wait with a three-step bounded wait process for bundled dev tests.
Mark waiting for the page's client registration as a temporary workaround.
Regression in 8.2: Vitest `setupFiles` fails with "Cannot find module" across Windows drive symlinks

nodes.text:
fix(html): don't inline preload and prefetch link targets

Extend the previous commit to `rel="preload"` and `rel="prefetch"`,
which are defeated by inlining for the same reason as `modulepreload`.

`<link rel="preload" as="image" imagesrcset>` goes through the srcset
branch, which called `processAssetUrl` without a `shouldInline`
argument and so ignored `noInlineLinkRels` entirely. Hoist the
no-inline decision out of the `src` branch so both use it.

Also drop the comment above `noInlineLinkRels` per review.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.text:
fix(html): don't inline modulepreload link targets

A `<link rel="modulepreload">` whose target is smaller than
`build.assetsInlineLimit` was rewritten to a `data:` URL. The browser
fetches that data URL as a module distinct from the emitted chunk, so
nothing referenced by the page is warmed and the preload is a no-op.

Add `modulepreload` to `noInlineLinkRels` so these targets are always
emitted as files, matching the existing handling for `icon` and
`manifest` links.

`preload`/`prefetch` links have the same problem but are left alone
here; they interact with #16269 and need to be handled separately.
